name: The False Flag
description: Confirmed real compromise: process hollowing in svchost.exe and LSASS credential dumping. On top of that real attack, the operator planted Cyrillic strings whose cleanliness contradicts the observed technical profile. The malice isn't Russian; it's the planter's.
devil_advocate: The process hollowing and credential dumping are real structural evidence of intrusion. The Cyrillic strings are planted to divert attribution.

custodyEvents.detail_es: Imagen de memoria y binario dropper adquiridos.

artifacts.description: Process hollowing confirmed in svchost.exe: a legitimate process hosting injected code while presenting as itself. Reflective DLL injection detected. Structural evidence that is hard to fake.
artifacts.description_es: Process hollowing confirmado en svchost.exe. Reflective DLL injection detectado. Evidencia estructural difícil de falsificar.

artifacts.description: LSASS credential dumping detected. Active compromise confirmed. Included for narrative completeness — the engine's detector suite has no dedicated credential-dumping category, so this artifact is context, not a scored contributor.
artifacts.description_es: LSASS credential dumping detectado. Compromiso activo confirmado.

artifacts.description: Cyrillic strings injected into the dropper. Linguistic profile too pristine, inconsistent with the observed technical OPSEC.
artifacts.description_es: Strings cirílicos inyectados en dropper. Perfil lingüístico demasiado prístino, inconsistente con el OPSEC técnico observado.

peirce_chain.firstness: Confirmed real attack + planted Cyrillic attribution.
peirce_chain.secondness: The cultural markers are too clean for the attacker's observed technical OPSEC level.
peirce_chain.thirdness: The real attack was used as a canvas to divert blame. The malice is the disinformation, not the nationality.

demo_quote: A genuine false flag has the attack present. VELO separates the real technical evidence from the planted attribution.
description_es: Compromiso real confirmado: process hollowing en svchost.exe y LSASS credential dumping. Sobre ese ataque real, el operador plantó strings cirílicos cuya limpieza contradice el perfil técnico observado. La malicia no es rusa; es del planter.
devil_advocate_es: El process hollowing y el credential dumping son evidencia estructural real de intrusión. Los strings cirílicos son plantados para desviar la atribución.
demo_quote_es: Una bandera falsa verdadera tiene el ataque presente. VELO separa la evidencia técnica real de la atribución plantada.

peirce_chain_es.firstness: Ataque real confirmado + atribución cirílica plantada.
peirce_chain_es.secondness: Los markers culturales son demasiado limpios para el nivel de OPSEC técnico del atacante.
peirce_chain_es.thirdness: El ataque real fue usado como lienzo para desviar la culpa. La malicia es la desinformación, no la nacionalidad.
